early_prediction: Genuinely split panel (4 positive: fundamental +18, base-rates +5, red-team +8, forensics +10; 3 negative: options-positioning -8, sentiment -14, macro-peers -20) nets to a coin-flip consensus of -0.1 — Neutral / No Edge is the honest read, not a suppressed lean. The dividing line is credit/take-rate trajectory versus headline growth: personas reading provisioning and ABS delinquency data lean down, personas reading demand, guidance-framework and insider/communication signals lean up. Main caveat: this is AFRM's initial FY2027 guide print, historically the widest-tailed of the year, and the Feb-2026 precedent (clean beat, guide raised, stock still fell 14.5% on a credit-provision jump) means direction hinges almost entirely on the margin/credit guide, not the FQ4 headline, which is near-certain to beat.
red_team_survival_note: Does not survive as a directional case, and that is itself informative. The red team built a specific, well-sourced bear case (the Feb-2026 beat-yet-fell precedent, rising delinquencies, a take-rate framework below the current run-rate) but concluded its own modal outcome is still up (+8), because the market already saw materially similar credit deterioration at the May-2026 print and bought the stock +21.8% anyway. Two other personas (options-positioning, macro-peers) independently flagged the same beat-and-fade risk from separate angles without citing the red team, which is why reversal_risk stays High (65) even though the red team's own score is not the panel's most bearish.
